Risk_scenario: Fraudster redirects an ACH or wire payment through compromised email or manipulated vendor data
Simulated_precondition: Independent trusted-source verification and segregation are absent
Recommended_treatment: Mitigate: callback verification; dual approval; segregation; alerts and limits

Risk_scenario: Stolen privileged credentials enable tenant-wide compromise
Simulated_precondition: Strong MFA, dedicated admin identities, least privilege, or reviews are incomplete
Recommended_treatment: Mitigate: privileged inventory; strong MFA; CA; separate admin accounts; monitoring

Risk_scenario: Ransomware or destructive activity causes prolonged outage and data loss
Simulated_precondition: Coverage, isolation, immutability, or restore testing is not evidenced
Recommended_treatment: Mitigate: approve RTO/RPO; resilient backups; credential separation; restore tests

Risk_scenario: Former or unintended external users retain sensitive project/corporate data access
Threat_event: Unauthorized disclosure via stale access or links
Simulated_precondition: External access and sharing are not recertified/restricted
Recommended_treatment: Mitigate: sharing guardrails; owner reviews; expiration; project closeout

Risk_scenario: Compromise or misuse of MSP access affects multiple critical systems
Simulated_precondition: Broad/shared access and governance, logging, or revocation are incomplete
Recommended_treatment: Mitigate: named least-privilege access; MFA; logging; reviews; contract controls

Risk_scenario: Lost or unmanaged job-site/BYOD device exposes company data
Simulated_precondition: MDM/MAM, encryption, EDR, or wipe status is unknown
Recommended_treatment: Investigate then mitigate based on verified coverage

Risk_scenario: VPN or flat network access permits unauthorized entry or lateral movement
Simulated_precondition: Architecture, MFA, segmentation, and review status are unknown
Recommended_treatment: Investigate architecture; harden and segment based on evidence

Risk_scenario: Delayed offboarding leaves former worker or subcontractor access active
Simulated_precondition: Lifecycle timing, ownership, and application coverage are unknown
Recommended_treatment: Define SLA; automate where feasible; reconcile and review
